messages:
sylvia: Kicking off a short planning thread for the upcoming pen test. Main asks: RBAC temp roles, audit snapshot/export, KMS proxy workflow, and retest booking. Can we align on a runbook?
omar: Yes. Preferred change window: Friday 09:00-11:00 PT. That gives us time to validate logs and handoff.
sylvia: OK locking 09:00-11:00 PT. Key constraints: no long-lived credentials, proxy must emit per-call logs, and audit objects must be immutable during evidence window.
nina: For KMS, prefer a proxy that performs Decrypt only for files in the evidence bucket and logs CMK key-id, caller, and ciphertext id. No DescribeKey permitted for assessor role.
trevor: Good. I'll build a policy like:
```
Allow: kms:Decrypt on arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456:key/abcd
Condition: StringEquals {"s3:ExistingObjectTag/evidence":"true"}
Expires: session max 3600s
```
sylvia: Add requirement: MFA and source IP = jumpbox. Also add a require for kms:ViaService? maybe not necessary. Ensure CloudTrail advanced logging is on.
omar: We'll snapshot CloudTrail and S3 inventory before the window and write immutable manifests (object lock retention) to a sealed bucket. Assessor gets presigned GETs for each object TTL=12h.
nina: How do we exchange ticket IDs for remediation? We want tracker entries with fields: vuln-id, severity, owner, mitigation plan, test-proof link, target retest window. Keep fields terse.
trevor: I'll template the ticket body and include a checklist that maps to evidence types. Example line: "proof: s3://audit-evidence/2026-03-xx/trace-123.log (presigned)".
sylvia: Retest policy: quick patch slot within 72h if severity >= high and fix validated via smoke tests. Full regression slot in 14 days for larger changes. Assessor should request retest with ticket link and proof artifacts.
omar: Ops playbook steps for the window:
1) create ephemeral role with 1h max
2) enable CloudTrail multi-region export to evidence bucket
3) deploy KMS proxy service behind VPN jump host
4) generate presigned links and log issuance
5) handoff to assessor with convo in this channel
6) snapshot post-window manifests
I'll upload a runbook PR to infra/runbooks in ~2 hours.
nina: One more: add an automated watcher to deny any changes to IAM policies during the window unless marked emergency. Set an alarm to #eng-oncall if triggered.
trevor: I'll add a terraform guardrail and a temporary policy lock. Will annotate the PR with rollback steps (terraform apply -target=module.rollback).
assessor-bot: Intake confirmed: external-assessor-team, start date 2026-03-27. Channel for assessor questions: #eng-security.
sylvia: Action items:
- trevor: draft KMS-restrictive policy + presign script (due: today EOD)
- omar: snapshot and seal audit before window and create presigned generation flow (due: tomorrow morning)
- nina: remediation ticket template + retest SLA doc (due: tomorrow EOD)
- sylvia: consolidate runbook and post PR link here (due: today end of day)
Any blockers?
